name: Cherng Talay — Clover Residence Villa CA18 · 5 bedrooms

name: Ayara Surin Villa · 5 bedrooms
description:
Ayara Surin is a 5-bedroom elegant villa located in the prestigious Ayara Surin complex on a picturesque hill between Surin and Bang Tao beaches on Phuket Island.

After a full renovation, the villa combines modern design, high comfort, privacy, and stunning panoramic views of the Andaman Sea. It is the ideal choice for a large family or a group of friends.

The villa's design is executed in light tones with red wood elements and Asian-style décor. Panoramic windows enhance the tropical living atmosphere and create a sense of tranquility. Due to its elevated location, beautiful sea views and unforgettable sunsets are visible from almost all main rooms.

The spacious living room combines a lounge area and a dining area for 12 guests. It features a soft sofa, coffee table, and air conditioning, while large glass doors lead to the pool terrace. The interior blends modern lighting and understated décor, creating an atmosphere of understated luxury.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped to European standards and has everything needed for a comfortable stay:

Additionally, a personal chef works at the villa (07:00–20:00) and can prepare dishes upon request. Grocery shopping is done according to receipts + 15% service fee.

The villa has 5 bedrooms with private bathrooms, each with access to the pool, garden, or terrace. All bedrooms are equipped with air conditioning and decorated in a unified style. The villa offers 8 sleeping places in total, with comfortable accommodation for up to 12 adult guests.

Master Bedroom: super king-size bed, daybed, walk-in closet area, dressing table, access to the pool.

Second Bedroom: super king-size bed, walk-in closet area, dressing table, television, daybed, access to the terrace.

Third Bedroom: super king-size bed, walk-in closet area, sofa, television, access to the terrace.

Fourth Bedroom: super king-size bed, walk-in closet area, dressing table, television, access to the terrace.

Fifth Bedroom: 4 single beds (transformable into 2 large double beds), walk-in closet area, 2 sofas, television, access to the terrace.

The villa grounds feature a 5 × 10 m infinity pool with views of the Andaman Sea, a private sauna, fitness gym, home cinema, billiards with a bar counter, and a barbecue area for breakfasts by the pool and friendly gatherings under the stars.

Guests of the complex enjoy high-speed Wi-Fi, security, and a private atmosphere.

The villa is located in the Ayara Surin complex, in the area between Surin and Bang Tao — one of the most popular and well-developed areas on Phuket.

Ayara Surin is a place where modern comfort meets natural harmony, impressive sea views, and complete privacy. It is the ideal choice for those seeking tranquility, a high level of service, and a stylish getaway on Phuket.

Included in the price: housekeeping, pool cleaning, garden maintenance, TV, Wi-Fi internet access, electricity, water, taxes, and fees.

name: Chalong — Casa Alma · 4 bedrooms
description:
Casa Alma is a 4-bedroom elegant villa located in the southwest of Phuket, on a scenic hill 60 meters above sea level.

Designed in a contemporary architectural style with refined Asian accents, it combines impeccable comfort, striking aesthetics, and absolute privacy. It is an ideal choice for a family holiday or a stylish getaway with friends.

Casa Alma makes an immediate impression: its architecture blends seamlessly into the natural landscape, while panoramic views of the turquoise waters of the Andaman Sea and the distant islands create a true sense of harmony with nature.

Floor-to-ceiling windows, natural materials, and carefully selected decorative elements emphasize the atmosphere of tropical luxury and tranquility.

The spacious living room is an elegant space where the lounge area flows naturally into the dining area and open terrace. It is furnished with a soft sofa, TV, and air conditioning, while large glass doors fill the interior with light and provide direct access to the pool.

The interior is complemented by natural-material décor, modern lighting, and vibrant Asian accents that give the space a distinctive character.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped to European standards and is suitable for both everyday living and entertaining guests:

The villa has 4 spacious bedrooms, each thoughtfully designed and with access to the terrace or pool. The interiors are unified in style: light, elegant, and filled with a sense of comfort and privacy. All bedrooms are equipped with air conditioning and en-suite bathrooms, ensuring maximum comfort for every guest.

Master bedroom: king-size bed, walk-in closet area, sofa, and work desk.

Second bedroom: king-size bed, walk-in closet area, and work desk.

Fourth bedroom: two single beds and a walk-in closet area, suitable for children or additional guests.

The villa features a private 17-meter saltwater infinity pool, spacious terraces with sun loungers, and an outdoor dining area. Nearby are a pool bar and a lounge space for relaxed downtime, social gatherings, and evening conversations. It is the perfect place for terrace breakfasts, leisurely days by the pool, and unforgettable evenings under the stars.

A special highlight of the villa is its secluded private beach, located just a few steps down the slope. Yanui and Rawai beaches are also within 2 kilometers, making the location especially attractive for those who value a peaceful seaside escape.

Casa Alma is located in the southwest of Phuket, one of the island’s calmest and most picturesque areas, where nature, the sea, and privacy create the perfect balance.

Casa Alma is a place where tropical nature reveals itself in its most refined form. It is the perfect choice for those seeking privacy, inspiration, and a truly stylish stay in Phuket.

name: Bang Tao — Infinity Blue Phuket · 4 bedrooms
description:
Infinity Blue Phuket is a 4-bedroom villa with a stunning beachfront location, just 30 minutes’ drive from Phuket Airport.

Infinity Blue consists of two single-storey pavilions set on a rectangular plot that stretches between a quiet road and the beach. Entering from the parking area, you first enter the Garden Pavilion, which houses two of the villa’s bedrooms; a covered corridor between the bedrooms leads to a tropical walled garden and koi pond. A path through the garden leads to the Sea View Pavilion, which contains two more bedrooms, a kitchen, living room and dining area. At the front of this pavilion is a furnished terrace overlooking the pool and beach.

The living room is an inviting gathering place, with floor-to-ceiling glass doors that open onto the terrace and pool. This air-conditioned space is furnished with grey sofas and armchairs, positioned in front of a large flat-screen TV. Satellite and cable internet service, a DVD player and a Bluetooth speaker make it easy to set the mood with movies or music. The living room can be completely opened up to the terrace and the cool sea breeze. Just beyond is the dining area with sea views and a table for four. The adjoining kitchen is well equipped with modern appliances and plenty of work space on black granite countertops.

Between the villa and the beach is a 15-metre pool edged with sand and an outdoor shower. At the front of the living pavilion is a covered terrace with a fan, furnished with a dining table and sofa, the perfect place for an evening sit-down or breakfast with the sea breeze. A small paradise garden with a koi pond surrounded by palm trees and tropical plants.

All four bedrooms of Infinity Blue are spacious and bright. All have en suite bathrooms with showers and are equipped with TVs, air conditioning and ceiling fans, as well as sliding glass doors that open either onto a sea-view terrace or onto the garden.

Two-bedroom apartment on the ground floor, just a 5-minute walk from Bang Tao Beach, with a total area of 178 sq.m, located in the prestigious Angsana Oceanview Residences complex by the lake, in the heart of the renowned Laguna Phuket resort area. Spacious modern interiors combine contemporary design with elements of traditional Thai style, inspired by the nature and culture of Phuket.

The apartment features a spacious living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and two bedrooms — each with its own en-suite bathroom. Large panoramic windows and a private balcony fill the space with natural light, creating a warm and relaxing atmosphere.

The main highlight is the private pool on the balcony, providing an exclusive sense of comfort and privacy.

The complex is within walking distance of Bang Tao Beach (about 5 minutes on foot). Nearby are the Banyan Tree and Angsana Laguna hotels, the Laguna Golf course, as well as numerous restaurants, cafes, spas, and shops. The area is known for its safety, well-maintained environment, and developed infrastructure.

The price includes cleaning, TV and Wi-Fi access, taxes, and fees.

name: Bang Tao — Angsana Oceanview · Penthouse · 2 bedrooms
description:
Angsana Oceanview is a brand-new 2-bedroom penthouse with a panoramic pool, located on the lakeside just 100 meters from Bang Tao Beach in the gated Angsana Oceanview Residences complex.

Created in a modern architectural style and featuring a terrace, it combines comfort, aesthetics, and privacy. It is an ideal choice for a family vacation or a group of up to 4 friends.

The penthouse design is finished in light tones combined with dark wood and Art Deco-inspired decorative elements. Floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows enhance the tropical atmosphere, while the breathtaking lake view creates a sense of peace and comfort.

The spacious living room combines a lounge area and a dining area for 4 guests. It features a soft sofa, armchairs, television, coffee table, chest of drawers, and air conditioning, while panoramic glass doors lead to the terrace with panoramic lake views.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped to European standards and has everything needed for a comfortable stay:

The penthouse has 2 bedrooms, each with access to the terrace. All bedrooms are equipped with private bathrooms, air conditioning, and are decorated in a unified style.

Master Bedroom: king-size bed, walk-in closet area, dressing table with mirror, television, banquette.

Second Bedroom: two single beds, walk-in closet area, dressing table with mirror, television, armchair.

The penthouse rooftop features a spacious terrace with a private infinity pool, sun loungers, a barbecue area, a dining set, and panoramic lake views. It is the perfect place for breakfasts by the pool and secluded evenings with sunset views.

Guests of the complex have access to a fitness center, spa, restaurants, and the infrastructure of Laguna Phuket.

The penthouse is located in Angsana Oceanview Residences — one of the most prestigious and well-developed areas of Phuket.

Angsana Oceanview Residence is a place where modern comfort meets the tropical luxury of Laguna Phuket. It is the ideal choice for those seeking a stylish getaway with lake views surrounded by first-class infrastructure.

name: Bang Tao — Banyan Pool Villa · 1 bedroom
description:
Banyan Pool Villa is a 1-bedroom tropical villa located by the sea in the gated Banyan Tree Phuket complex in a picturesque part of Phuket.

Designed in a contemporary architectural style with Eastern decor elements, it combines comfort, aesthetics, and absolute privacy. The perfect choice for a couple or a secluded getaway for up to 2 people.

The villa's design features natural tones, emphasizing harmony with nature and natural light. Wooden elements and panoramic windows highlight the tropical lifestyle atmosphere, while views of the private pool and garden create a sense of peace and luxury.

The villa is equipped with coffee and tea making facilities, as well as a dining set for 2 people.

The villa offers 1 spacious bedroom with direct access to the pool and garden. The room is designed in an Eastern style and features a comfortable Japanese bed, dressing area, air conditioning, work desk, sofa, and coffee table. The bedroom opens to both an indoor bathroom and an outdoor shower.

From the luxurious interior, you step directly onto a spacious wooden terrace with a cozy shaded corner. Here you'll find a private 14 sq.m. pool with jacuzzi, sun loungers, and a dining area. It's the ideal spot for poolside relaxation, leisurely breakfasts, or dinners under the open sky.

The complex offers guests access to a beach club, restaurants, spa center, and fitness area.

The villa is located in the Banyan Tree Phuket complex — one of the island's most popular and well-appointed destinations.

Banyan Pool Villa is where modern comfort meets natural harmony and tropical luxury. The ideal choice for those seeking tranquility and stylish relaxation in Phuket for two.

name: Phuket — Inasia Beach Villa · 8 bedroom
description:
We are pleased to present a luxurious 8-bedroom oceanfront villa—an exclusive beachfront estate with two swimming pools, blending elegance and tropical luxury while overlooking one of Koh Samui's finest beaches, Lipa Noi, on its picturesque western coast.

This villa consists of two adjoining modern properties, offering eight en-suite double bedrooms, comfortably accommodating up to 16 guests. Perfect for large groups and family vacations, the villa provides everything you need for a beachfront escape: two infinity pools, expansive terraces, an outdoor bar, a sophisticated living and dining area, a billiard table, and manicured lawns that gently slope down to the beach.

The central beachfront villa features separate living and dining spaces, a landscaped garden, and views of the 15-meter L-shaped infinity pool and lawns leading to the shore.

On the other hand, the three-level oceanfront villa at the rear is centered around an eight-meter infinity pool and a terrace with a gazebo. The villa is self-contained and has a fully equipped kitchen, living room and games room with a full-size pool table.

The décor reflects a contemporary style enriched with Asian accents and artifacts. Each bedroom is equipped with a comfortable king-size bed, crisp white linens, and luxurious en-suite bathrooms featuring tropical rain showers or bathtubs.

The lawned gardens and beach are ideal for yoga or massages, which can be arranged by the villa manager. Relaxing in such an inspiring setting will leave you feeling refreshed and invigorated. The villa’s incredible location makes it a popular venue for events, weddings and celebrations.

A dedicated villa manager, concierge, and chef are on hand to deliver an unforgettable experience and a carefree stay. We’ll take care of every detail, from meal planning and spa treatments to organizing tours and shopping trips. Your chef will transform dining into a true pleasure, preparing authentic Thai dishes with fresh, local ingredients as well as exquisite international cuisine. Special dietary needs and personalized menus for children can also be accommodated to ensure everyone enjoys their vacation.

Located on a 10-kilometer stretch of untouched beach in Phang Nga Province, Grand Villa Noi occupies a prime spot on the white sands of Natai Beach. The villa is a peaceful oasis, surrounded by lush greenery, tropical gardens, and tall trees swaying in the wind. The villa offers breathtaking sea views that you can enjoy throughout your stay.

The main building of the villa is spread across two levels, designed in a modern style with glass walls. It features a spacious open-plan kitchen with a long dining table. Above the kitchen are the master bedroom and one guest bedroom, making it ideal for families with children. The other three bedrooms are separate pavilions, connected by a wooden terrace.

The air-conditioned family living room is located at the front of the villa. Panoramic windows provide an endless view of the ocean. The living room includes a variety of board games, a billiard table, a dedicated children's area, a small library, a writing desk, and a wine cooler.

The modern open-plan kitchen occupies one corner of the main building and smoothly transitions into the dining area with a long eight-seat table. Floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors allow you to choose between alfresco or air-conditioned dining, with a view of the pool and terrace.

In front of the villa is a spacious wooden deck terrace that frames the landscape pool. Around the pool, sun loungers are strategically placed, while tropical trees provide natural shade, protecting you from the sun.

The outdoor living area is set amidst a lush tropical garden and has direct access to the soft sands of Natai Beach—a pristine 10-kilometer stretch of coastline.

All five luxurious bedrooms in Grand Villa Noi are spacious and equipped with double beds and ensuite bathrooms. Each is designed with privacy in mind, offering stunning sea views, ceiling fans, and air-conditioning.

The master bedroom is located on the upper level. It features floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass doors leading to a balcony with comfortable chairs, offering magnificent views of the sea. In one corner of the room is a round double bed, facing a flat-screen TV. The spacious ensuite bathroom includes a jacuzzi and a separate rain shower.

Angsana Beachfront Residence | Apartment 6611 | 2 bedrooms | Lake View

The 3-bedroom ground-floor apartment offers a lake view with a private pool, just 50 meters from Bangtao Beach. name: Bang Tao — Hale Malia Villa · Samsara Estate · 4 bedroom
description:
4-bedroom oceanfront villa with a modern ambience and classic Asian decor located on the west coast of Phuket

Infinity pool with built-in Jacuzzi, offering stunning views of the lush green gardens and the Andaman Sea. An outdoor terrace has professional BBQ equipment and a large dining table.

Luxurious furnished living rooms are equipped with TV, CD, DVD and iPod dock. The villa also has a private sauna and steam room. Fully equipped European kitchen with everything you need for a long stay: refrigerator, microwave, oven, blender, coffee machine, juicer, toaster.

The master bedroom has a king size bed, bathroom with shower and en-suite bath, individual air conditioning, safe.

Two guest bedrooms are equipped with large double beds and one guest room with two single beds.

The villa's location is a stunning combination of rocky coastline, tropical gardens and calming views of the open sea. From a rocky elevation 40 meters above sea level, the villa offers breathtaking panoramic views of the ocean coast and Patong Bay.

name: Kamala — Fan Sai Villa · Samsara Estate · 5 bedroom
description:
The 5-bedroom oceanfront villa is located just eight minutes’ drive from Patong on Phuket’s west coast

The villa combines contemporary design elements with the refined amenities of a luxurious tropical getaway.

The modern two-level home is designed to provide uninterrupted panoramic views from all its spacious rooms. Upon entering, you are welcomed into a sunlit living room, illuminated by natural light streaming through the paneled glass facade. This facade can be opened to let in the gentle ocean breeze.

The dining area leads into a bright kitchen, which is fully equipped with the latest appliances and everything you need for comfortable living. The adjoining terrace offers dining with ocean views.

With the exception of the master bedroom, which is nestled in a quiet corner on the upper level, all bedrooms open out onto a spacious pool deck on the lower level of the villa, the perfect place to gather over sunset cocktails.

The villa has a games room equipped with a flat-screen TV, a treadmill, and tempting sea views. And an indoor jacuzzi adds another opportunity for a pleasant stay.

name: Bang Tao — Infinity View Villa · 5 bedroom
description:
A 4-bedroom villa with a modern Asian vibe, stunning sea views, an infinity pool and a private garden located on the southwest coast of Phuket.

The villa has been designed to take advantage of the stunning sea views from its rooms, with floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors and spacious rooms.

Enjoy the outdoors by relaxing on the private deck surrounding the 10-metre pool with six sun loungers, two large dining tables, a sunken sofa and a foosball table. There is a BBQ area to host a party or enjoy an outdoor breakfast with the Andaman Sea as a backdrop.

The villa has a contemporary Asian feel, with rooms decorated with vibrant artwork, sculptures and Thai-style teak furniture. The air-conditioned dining room comfortably seats six, and the kitchen is fully equipped. There is a well-equipped gym at the villa.

The villa is situated on a cape overlooking Kata Noi Beach, a small bay with white sand and crystal-clear water. Kata Noi and Kata Beaches are just a five-minute walk away.

The villa is also just a five-minute walk from all the shops and restaurants at Kata Beach, where you will find a wider selection of dining options, boutique stores, tour operators, and pubs for an enjoyable evening out.

Created in a contemporary architectural style with elements of Thai‑Balinese décor, it combines comfort, aesthetics, and privacy. It is an ideal choice for a family holiday or a group of friends.

The villa’s design features natural and neutral tones, with an emphasis on harmony with nature and natural light. Floor‑to‑ceiling panoramic glass windows and doors highlight the tropical setting, while views of the pool and landscaped green grounds create a sense of peace and comfort. The villa is single‑storey, spacious, and bright, with a thoughtful layout for comfortable living.

The spacious living room combines a lounge area and a dining space for 8 guests. It features a soft sofa, TV, and air conditioning, with large glass doors opening onto the pool terrace. The interior is tastefully finished: décor in natural materials, a coffee table, and modern lighting create an elegant yet cosy atmosphere.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped to European standards and includes everything needed for a comfortable stay:

The villa has 4 bedrooms, each with access to the pool or terrace. All bedrooms are equipped with en‑suite bathrooms, air conditioning, and are decorated in a unified style.

Second bedroom: king-size bed, walk-in closet area, and dressing table.

Third bedroom: king-size bed, walk-in closet area, and dressing table.

Fourth bedroom: two single beds, walk-in closet area, and dressing table.

The villa features a private pool, a spacious terrace with sun loungers, and a barbecue area. Nearby is an outdoor dining set — the perfect setting for poolside breakfasts, daytime relaxation, and warm evening gatherings under the stars.

The villa is located in the Botanica Foresta project — an elite residential complex near Layan Beach, in the northern part of Bang Tao, one of the quietest and most well‑developed areas of Phuket. The project includes 83 villas in Thai‑Balinese and contemporary design, which distinguishes the complex with its variety of architectural solutions and style.

name: Bang Tao — Angsana Lake view Royal Villa 116/19 · 4 bedrooms
description:
Angsana Lake View Royal Villa 116/19 is a spacious 4-bedroom family residence located in the prestigious 5-star Angsana Villas complex, in the heart of the Laguna Phuket resort.

This two-story villa is designed in a modern Asian style, combining homely warmth, premium comfort, and picturesque views of a tropical lake. It is the perfect choice for a large family or group of friends who appreciate developed infrastructure and high-level service.

The villa’s design features light, natural tones and high-quality natural materials, emphasizing harmony with the surrounding environment. Panoramic windows and spacious terraces on both floors flood the space with natural light, while views of the calm lake and tropical garden create an atmosphere of serenity and privacy.

The villa offers two living areas for maximum guest comfort.

Ground Floor: A bright living room connected to the kitchen, with direct access to the pool.

Second Floor: An additional cozy living area opening onto a scenic terrace.

Both zones are furnished with plush sofas, TVs, and air conditioning, creating ideal conditions for social gatherings or quiet relaxation.

The modern kitchen on the ground floor is fully equipped for a comfortable stay:

The space is thoughtfully designed to make cooking your favorite meals easy and enjoyable, even while on vacation. Nearby there is a dining area for 8 people with a view of the pool.

The villa features 4 comfortable bedrooms intelligently distributed across two floors. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning and wardrobes.

Ground Floor: A bedroom with a Queen-size bed — ideal for guests or elderly family members as it requires no stairs. A bathroom with a shower is located nearby.

Master Bedroom: A spacious room with a King-size bed, terrace access, and a private ensuite bathroom.

Two Guest Bedrooms: Cozy and bright rooms sharing a common bathroom on the floor.

The villa’s focal point is the private ground-floor terrace with a personal pool and lake views.

Here you will find sun loungers and a cozy gazebo (sala), perfect for enjoying morning coffee or evening cocktails in the fresh air.

The villa is situated in one of Phuket's most sought-after locations — Laguna Phuket.

5 minutes to Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket shopping galleries with restaurants and Villa Market supermarket.

7 minutes to the pristine white sands of Bang Tao Beach and beach clubs like Catch, Xana, and Maya.

Angsana Lake View Royal Villa 116/19 is where family comfort meets the privileges of a 5-star resort. Here, you can enjoy the privacy of your own villa while having the entire infrastructure of Laguna Phuket at your fingertips. The ideal choice for those seeking a carefree, vibrant, and stylish vacation in Phuket.
